0.original: Ghimthota, a captain of the watch at the Moraby Drydocks, wishes your aid in dealing with potential intruders.

1.original: Ghimthota is convinced that a gang of treacherous pirates aims to sabotage the construction of the <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103>. Speak with either Urswyrst at the front gate or C'nangho at the rear gate to learn of any suspicious activity.

2.original: You have spoken with one of the guards and heard a report concerning a possible saboteur. Make your way to the cliff at Empty Heart and learn what trouble is afoot.

3.original: You have confronted the suspicious sailor, and he leaves you with words that send a chill down your spine. Hurry back to the Drydocks and report to Ghimthota.

4.original: You have succeeded in preventing the destruction of the <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103>. It has come to light, however, that the leader of the pirates, Ahtzapfyn, is actually Ahtbyrm's father. Speak with the troubled foreman, and see how he fares.

5.original: Though he puts on a brave face, it is clear that Ahtbyrm is deeply shaken by his father's unexpected appearance. Return to Ghimthota and convey Ahtbyrm's gratitude and apologies.

6.original: Ghimthota appears convinced that a swift return to work on the <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103> will soon ease Ahtbyrm's troubled heart. The watch captain thanks you for your assistance, and mentions that the would-be saboteurs have been handed over to the Yellowjackets. There has, however, been an important discovery that she would like to discuss with you.

24.original: Speak with one of the guards.

26.original: Report to Ghimthota at the Moraby Drydocks.

48.original: I am concerned, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. It appears that the pirates I had you investigate are on the move.

49.original: They creep ever closer to the Drydocks, so I must assume they mean to target the <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103> herself.

50.original: That ship is the symbol of everything Limsa Lominsa strives to become, and I will not allow these base scoundrels to lay a single finger upon her hull.

51.original: We must apprehend them before they put their plans into motion! And you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, are just the <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> to do it.

52.original: Without your capable assistance, I fear the security of the Drydocks cannot be guaranteed.

53.original: Not moments ago, my guards submitted reports of suspicious activity in the area. Pray begin your efforts by listening to one of their accounts firsthand.

54.original: It matters not whom you choose to speak with, but be sure to question either Urswyrst at the front gate or C'nangho at the rear.

55.original: Any suspect saboteurs you encounter during the course of your investigation are to be interrogated. Report any and all findings directly to me.

56.original: Ghimthota sent you to follow up on my report?

57.original: Well, it was not too long ago that I saw some unsavory sort slinking along the top of the bluff near Empty Heart, just over yonder.

58.original: It may be that he's still about. If you've got the time, adventurer, I'd much appreciate you getting up there to take a look.

59.original: Hail, adventurer. Glad to have another hand aboard to help shore up security.

60.original: The gods know our reports would sit on Ghimthota's desk gathering dust if it weren't for the assistance of those such as yourself.

61.original: Speaking of reports, though, I saw one of those mangy pirates lurking around the cliff near Empty Heart. I'd take a closer look before he has a chance to cover his tracks.

62.original: Bah, spotted me, did ye? Well, yer too late─what's to 'appen is already 'appenin'.

63.original: Duty calls. Do you wish to proceed with<hex:02100103>“Victory in Peril”?

66.original: So, you found me one of those pirates, did you?

67.original: I knew you were the right adventurer to ask for aid.

68.original: But what could these knaves be planning? “What's to happen is already happening”...?

70.original: Easy now, soldier. Who did this to you?

71.original: <pant> Pirates... Out of nowhere... <cough> Stuck me good...

72.original: Gods below, we are not prepared for this!

73.original: The pirates, soldier, how many do they number?

74.original: Not sure... More than I could quickly count... Seemed to be carrying...explosives...

75.original: Explosives!? Then there is no time to lose!

76.original: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, you heard the situation. Make your way to the shipyard and engage these intruders!

77.original: I will see to this man's wounds, then follow after.

79.original: Gahahaha! Never reckoned it'd be this easy! Still don't trust those slimy bastards, but their plan worked like a charm!

80.original: Da! What are you doing, you great bloody fool!?

82.original: This'll all be over soon. All that's left now is to blow this ugly pile o' driftwood into splinters.

83.original: Why would you do such a thing!? Have you any idea how important this ship is? What it represents?

84.original: Aye, an' that's what makes it all the sweeter! Whatever it takes to knock some sense into me treacherous, backstabbin' son!

85.original: Imagine, a boy o' <hex:021A020203>mine<hex:021A020103> givin' up the pirate life to become a shipwright! An' buildin' a bleedin' Maelstrom vessel at that! What under Llymlaen's wide, green ocean made ye take up with these self-righteous shites!?

86.original: You're the one with no bloody sense, Da! Don't you see? The pirates had their glory days, but that era is over!

87.original: Ah! I wondered why Ahtbyrm never spoke of his father. I never would have thought...

88.original: This ship's a symbol alright─of everythin' what went wrong with the world. An' I mean to shatter it into a hunnerd thousand pieces!

89.original: Ghimthota! <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Pray beat the tar out of this bloated sea slug, and make sure no harm comes to the <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103>!

90.original: I...I must be gettin' old, lettin' some green 'venturer get the best o' me.

92.original: <cough> That's one big bloody ship. Big...an' nasty lookin'. Ye made that, did ye...?

93.original: My thanks, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I shudder to think what may have become of the <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103> without your intervention.

94.original: <sigh> The pirates have made a right mess of things─I'd best get to sorting out the docks.

95.original: ...And my thoughts could use some sorting out as well. Ever did my father have a way of turning my life upside down.

96.original: Pray convey my thanks─and my apologies─to Ghimthota.

97.original: How fare you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? I cannot begin to thank you for the role you played in preventing this madness.

98.original: You defended more than a simple ship─you saved the budding hope of Limsa Lominsa from a violent demise. The day was yours.

99.original: It seems our security regimen will require much in the way of improvement if we are to truly keep the Drydocks safe.

100.original: ...Ahtbyrm apologizes? Well, I suppose I can understand why he would feel responsible for his father's actions. Of all those involved, this incident was hardest on him.

101.original: But, in time, I believe he will come to a single conclusion: the most fitting way of moving past his anguish is to see the <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103> completed and in the water.

102.original: Ah, by the by, the pirates we defeated have been handed over to the Yellowjackets. Reyner's men will be taking over the investigation.

103.original: Before the Yellowjackets moved in, however, we recovered a most unusual object. Should you have the time to spare, I would ask of you another favor...

104.original: Defeat the pirates and protect the <hex:021A020203>Victory<hex:021A020103>!

107.original: My father... You must stop him!

108.original: Leave him to us.<hex:02100103><hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, C'nangho, to me!

111.original: I'll take the Mamool Ja. You focus on Ahtzapfyn.

112.original: Ye've no idea who yer up against!

114.original: Please! You cannot let him win!

115.original: Ware, adventurer!<hex:02100103>Ahtzapfyn has a crazy glint in his eye...
